decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric sits squarely in the firm's core upholstery know-how and keeps its own website page, so management can interpret its market response and refine it through in-house development.

Flame-retardant jacquard curtains for contract and hospitality projects draw directly on the firm's functional-fabric knowledge and fit its strategic focus, which makes it a low-risk product to keep developing.

The wool bouclé leno builds on the firm's sheer and wool expertise and supports its sustainability direction, but it is only mentioned on the website and resembles the withdrawn bouclé and wool products, so its risk is moderately higher while the firm still has the knowledge to improve it.

The braided-structure fabric was launched recently with its own page and extends the firm's established upholstery and curtain know-how, so it is too early to judge it and the firm is well placed to learn from its early results.
